title_zh: 约好先了解英国咨询服务的会谈安排

scenario.label_zh: 约好先了解英国咨询服务的会谈安排
scenario.goal_zh: 询问首次咨询是否需要讲述全部经历，并预约一次只了解流程的电话

context_zh: 虚构英国社区机构：成年人向接待员了解心理咨询服务；不提供医疗建议。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Moira
sentences.text: I saw your notice about counselling. Do I have to explain my whole history in the first appointment?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: You can ask the counsellor about the process before deciding what you want to discuss.

sentences.speaker: Moira
sentences.text: Could I have a short call about the arrangements first, rather than book a full session?

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: Yes. We offer a ten-minute information call. Would Thursday at eleven suit you?

sentences.speaker: Moira
sentences.text: Yes, please. I only want to understand the process on that call.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist
sentences.text: I've reserved Thursday at eleven for an information call, not a counselling session. The counsellor will call the number you gave us.
